description: This bar chart compares the execution accuracy of two text-to-SQL generation models, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents Execution Accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four categories in order from left to right. For each category, two adjacent bars are displayed: a light blue bar representing NatSQL and a darker blue bar representing TA-SQL. The values are explicitly labeled on top of each bar. In the Simple category, NatSQL achieves an accuracy of 60.21 while TA-SQL achieves 63.14. In the Moderate category, NatSQL scores 39.64 and TA-SQL scores 48.60. In the Challenging category, NatSQL scores 32.32 and TA-SQL scores 36.11. The Total category aggregates these scores, showing NatSQL at 51.35 and TA-SQL at 56.19. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the categories listed on the horizontal axis. The chart uses a legend to distinguish the two models, with the light blue bar corresponding to NatSQL and the darker blue bar to TA-SQL.
